test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

The government has been accused in not doing enough to combat climate change.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'accused in.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

 
• The error lies in the usage of "in" </s
